1.note: conversation('order-<id>').createIfNotExists({ subject, custom: { orderId, listingId } }) + participant(buyer|seller).createIfNotExists(); custom data is string-only

2.note: send({ text, custom: { type: 'order_card', card: JSON } }); order service edits with PUT /conversations/{id}/messages/{mid} { custom }; subscribeMessages snapshot diff (editedAt) surfaces the update

3.note: contact masking is a per-role dashboard setting (phone, email, custom regex; all plans) and was not configured on this app at run time: 0/4 blocked. No report API: reportUser goes to our own queue

4.note: TalkJS emails offline participants itself (Postmark) after an inactivity window; no custom SMTP, so Mailpit cannot receive it. Check observes the notification.* webhook instead. Browser push (FCM + service worker) exists per the docs; not evaluated (out of scope)

5.note: message.translate(lang) from @talkjs/core 1.12 on receive, needs Growth plan + Google key in Settings → Localization; built fallback (custom.translations from our provider) otherwise
5.gate: Growth plan + Google Cloud Translation key

6.note: conversation.participant('agent_sam').createIfNotExists({ access: 'ReadWrite', notify: true }); full history visible to the new participant

7.note: markAsRead + conversation.everyoneReadUntil as the receipt; markAsTyping (no explicit stop) + subscribeTyping; uploadImage -> send({ content: [{ type: 'file', fileToken }] })
